title: SketchMeasurements
description: What the operator entered for one sketch capture (spec F14): the rooms as drawn, the walls around each room in order, the lengths, diagonals and openings that were measured, and the ceiling height. The sketch solver turns this into the capture model; the file is kept unchanged as the capture's original, next to the sketch image, as Original Exports/{areaKey}/{captureId}/sketch-measurements.json with role sketch_measurements. Lengths are stored in millimetres with the unit and text the operator entered. Optional fields are omitted, never null.

displayUnits.description: The unit system the operator worked in.

kind.description: hand_sketch: a sketch drawn on site; existing_plan: a printed or drawn plan of the property; ar_walkthrough: converted from an AR walkthrough (spec F15), every length measured by the phone; none: measurements only, no drawing.

path.description: Package path of the sketch image (role sketch_image), or of the walkthrough log (role walkthrough_log) for ar_walkthrough. Present exactly when kind is not none.

interpretation.description: Package path of the sketch interpretation (role sketch_interpretation) when Claude read the sketch (spec F16). Only with hand_sketch or existing_plan.

ceilingHeight.description: Floor-to-ceiling height of the floor, used by every room that has no ceilingHeight of its own. Omitted when the operator did not measure it: the solver then assumes 2440 mm and the capture is limited.

areaKey.description: Key of the floor or area in the capture record, for example floor-1.

id.description: Element id, unique within the file. The solver keeps these ids in the capture model.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the package root, forward slashes, no '.' or '..' segments.

enteredUnit.description: Unit the operator entered the value in. ft_in is feet and inches, for example 24' 8".

length.description: One entered length. measured false is an "about" value the operator estimated by eye; the solver marks what it builds from it as estimated.

enteredText.description: The value exactly as the operator entered it, in enteredUnit.

measured.description: True when read from a tape or laser (or printed on the existing plan); false for an estimate.

turn.description: The corner at the end of a wall, where the next wall starts: left, a square convex corner (the outline turns 90 degrees left, counter-clockwise); right, a square re-entrant corner (90 degrees right, the inside corner of an L); unsquare, a corner that is not 90 degrees, measured by a diagonal across it. Absent means left.

label.description: Room name as the operator wrote it, for example Kitchen.

type.description: What the room is used for, when the operator chose it.

walls.description: The walls around the room in order, counter-clockwise seen from above as drawn. Corner i is the start of wall i; the last wall ends at corner 0.

diagonals.description: Corner-to-corner distances measured through the room: one across each unsquare corner, or one for a squareness check. Empty when none.

openings.description: Doors, windows and openings in this room's walls. Empty when none.

ceilingHeight.description: This room's ceiling height when it differs from the floor's.

placement.description: Where the room sits in the capture frame, when it was measured there (an AR walkthrough, spec F15): corner 0 at (x, z) in metres and wall 0 leaving it at angleDeg, counter-clockwise from +x seen from +Y. The solver keeps the room there and does not place it by sharedWith. Omitted for a typed sketch.

furniture.description: Furniture drawn in the room (spec F16), in the capture frame. Reference geometry only.

length.description: The wall's length along the inside face. Omitted when the operator did not enter one: the solver fills it from closure when it can, else from an estimate.

exterior.description: True for an exterior wall (drawn thicker, 6 in; interior walls are 4.5 in). Absent means interior.

sharedWith.description: The wall of an earlier room in this file that is the other side of the same partition. The solver places this room against that one.

from.description: Index of the first corner (the start of wall from).

to.description: Index of the second corner; not from or a neighbour of it.

kind.description: door, a door; window, a window; opening, an opening without a door (passage, arch).

wallId.description: The wall of this room the opening is in.

width.description: Clear width. Omitted: the solver uses 914 mm for a door and 1219 mm for a window or opening, estimated.

height.description: Height of the opening. Omitted: 2032 mm for a door, 1219 mm for a window, the wall height for an opening, estimated.

sill.description: Windows: height of the sill above the floor. Omitted: 914 mm, estimated. Doors and openings have no sill.

fromCorner.description: Which corner of the wall fromCornerDistance is measured from: start, the wall's start corner; end, its end corner.

fromCornerDistance.description: Distance from that corner to the nearest jamb of the opening. Omitted: the opening is placed by the order of the openings on the wall, estimated.

x.description: Centre x in the capture frame, metres.

z.description: Centre z in the capture frame, metres.

angleDeg.description: Rotation about +Y, counter-clockwise seen from +Y, degrees.
